en.automaticSpeechHint: Speaks final assistant responses. Manual replay always remains available.
en.cleanMarkdownHint: Converts Markdown into natural speech text.
en.codeBlockMaxCharsHint: Only used by Smart code blocks.
en.codeBlockReplacementTextHint: Used when a code block is replaced.
en.codeBlocksHint: Choose how fenced code blocks are spoken.
en.commandDoneHint: Announces when a command finishes or fails.
en.engineHint: Custom engine script path; empty = auto-resolve (package engine → ~/.dsh/hooks).
en.fixedPromptHint: The prompt spoken when the text is too long (message mode).
en.longTextBehaviorHint: When a positive maximum is exceeded.
en.masterSwitchHint: Temporarily enable or disable all announcements.
en.maxCharsHint: 0 is unlimited on macOS; Windows keeps its safe default.
en.queueAllMessagesHint: Also speaks intermediate assistant messages in a FIFO queue, not only the final reply.
en.rateHintMac: words-per-minute (wpm) — higher = faster: default 175, 200 is a bit faster.
en.rateHintWin: Windows SAPI rate scale (-10 to 10, 0 = normal; try 1-3 for faster).
en.readInlineCodeHint: Reads inline code without backtick markers.
en.replayFullReadHint: When replaying, read the full text instead of the heading fallback.
en.settingsIntro: Speech preferences for automatic announcements and per-message replay.
en.stripApprovalPrefixHint: Strip the fixed English template prefix (escalate sandbox to …:) from approval reasons.
en.throttleMsHint: How long a reply waits before being announced (merges multi-step messages).
en.todoWriteHint: Announces when the agent updates its todos.
en.toolErrorsHint: Announces an error summary when a tool call fails.
en.turnEndHint: Announces when a round of conversation ends.
en.volumeHint: Windows only (0-100); macOS volume follows the system.
